title: Validation Center UI target catalog missing /research-pipeline nav route
description:
Expected: Validation Center UI target catalog should include every frontend navigation href, including /research-pipeline, or the nav/catalog contract should be updated so validation_center_backend passes independently of unrelated miniQMT fixes.
Actual: GitHub PR #62 CI failed in Backend tests (validation_center_backend). The failing test is backend/tests/test_validation_ui_target_catalog.py::test_default_ui_target_catalog_matches_frontend_nav_groups, with AssertionError because nav_hrefs - target_hrefs == {'/research-pipeline'} instead of empty set. Local rerun in BUG-048 worktree reproduced the same failure: 1 failed, 100 passed in validation_center_backend. PR #62 changed only qmt_strategy_ledger board-lot files, BUG-048 JSON, and a qmt_strategy_ledger validation record; it did not touch frontend/src/lib/navigation/nav-groups.ts, tests/aistock_validation/catalog/ui_targets.yaml, or validation center code.
reproduce_command: conda run -n AIstock python -m nox -s validation_center_backend
required_verification: conda run -n AIstock python -m nox -s validation_center_backend
conda run -n AIstock python -m nox -s validation_module_registry_l0
conda run -n AIstock python -m nox -s l0
closure_requirements: ui_targets.yaml includes exactly one target for /research-pipeline that matches NAV_GROUPS
validation_center_backend passes on the fix branch
BUG-060 fix branch is pushed and linked to GitHub issue #64
Validation history records commands, results, residual risks, and production impact

events.note: Discovered while validating PR #62 for BUG-048; appears unrelated to BUG-048 because the PR diff does not touch navigation or validation catalog files.
Failure text: AssertionError: assert {'/research-pipeline'} == set(), extra item '/research-pipeline'.
Local rerun in F:\Dev\AIstock_worktrees\bug-048-miniqmt-board-lot reproduced the same validation_center_backend failure.
Mirrored BUG-060 to GitHub issue #64 via gh CLI after validation_center_backend CI failure on PR #62.

Assigned BUG-060 for isolated fix in worktree F:\Dev\AIstock_worktrees\bug-060-validation-ui-target-catalog on branch bug/BUG-060-validation-ui-target-catalog. Production 8001/3000 and MiniQMT runtime are out of scope.

Added /research-pipeline to Validation Center ui_targets.yaml and validated with targeted pytest, validation_center_backend, validation_module_registry_l0, l0, and git diff --check. Validation record: tests/aistock_validation/history/validation_center/20260519_152612_l2_bug-060-research-pipeline-ui-target-catalog.md.

guardrail_changed_files showed BUG JSON records under tests/aistock_validation/bugs were unmapped by file ownership, so scope was expanded to tests/aistock_validation/catalog/file_ownership.yaml and a validation_bug_registry ownership rule was added to let BUG-060 source-of-truth records pass changed-file guardrails.
Local fix committed on bug/BUG-060-validation-ui-target-catalog as ae39442.
